user.title: Cloud Inverter Setup
user.description: Choose where Home Assistant should read inverter data.

select_inverter.title: Select Your Inverter
select_inverter.description:
Multiple inverters found. Please select which one to monitor.

Note: The ID shown (e.g., ABCDE123456789) matches the serial number printed on your inverter device.

local.title: Local Analyzer
local.description: Run the SolarMax local analyzer on your LAN first. Enter its host and port separately. The default port is 8765; Home Assistant reads cached data without polling the inverter directly.

direct.title: Direct SolarMax PV9000
direct.description: Home Assistant reads the inverter directly over your LAN. Use its IP address and Modbus/TCP port (usually 502). The default collection interval is 180 seconds. Ten-second polling can interrupt cloud uploads and turn the datalogger light red; quiet windows are only a precaution.

init.description: Change the host, port, or refresh interval. For direct mode, the interval controls inverter collection; for analyzer mode, it controls cache reads.
